key_points: Quarterly revenue hit record $94.9B (+6% YoY), driven by Services record $25.2B (+14% YoY).
iPhone returned to positive growth with strong upgrade momentum across all geographic segments.
Active installed base reached an all-time historical high across every device category.
Gross margin expanded to 46.2%, at the upper limit of management guidance range.

guidance.revenue: Low-to-mid single digits YoY growth in December quarter

red_flags: Foreign exchange headwinds expected to drag revenue growth by ~150 bps in Q1.
Intense competitive pressures in Greater China smartphone landscape.

key_quotes.speaker: Tim Cook
key_quotes.quote: We generated all-time record Services revenue of $25.2 billion, up 14% year over year.

key_quotes.speaker: Luca Maestri
key_quotes.quote: Gross margin at 46.2% reflected disciplined cost management and favorable product mix.

operational_highlights: Apple Intelligence rollout driving early user engagement and device upgrade interest
$25B+ returned to shareholders through aggressive share buybacks and dividends
analysis.capital_allocation: Over $25 billion returned to shareholders via $20.4B share repurchases and $3.7B cash dividends.
